name: Designer — split pane resize control is accessible and bounded

planSteps.description: There is a vertical separator control with accessible label "Resize chat sidebar".
Drag the vertical separator noticeably to the right, then release it.
Both the chat panel and canvas panel remain visible after resizing; neither pane collapses to zero width.
The /fixed route still shows "Room Designer", "agent ready", and the canvas empty-state title "No layout yet" after reload.
